claims.claim: OpenAI says GPT-6 Sol and Luna are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users, with gradual rollout.
claims.safeFraming: State the named surfaces and plans; tell readers that access may not yet appear.

claims.claim: The release says the models are not yet available in Chat.
claims.safeFraming: Do not imply ordinary Chat access.

claims.claim: The release lists input/output API prices per million tokens for Sol and Luna.
claims.safeFraming: Identify prices as API pricing and date-check before publication.

claims.claim: OpenAI reports benchmark, factuality, coding, and computer-use comparisons.
claims.safeFraming: Attribute each comparison and preserve stated evaluation limitations; do not translate it into a general promise for every reader task.

excludedClaims: That all subscribers have access now.
That provider benchmark results predict an individual reader outcome.
That API price equals ChatGPT subscription cost.
